commands.step: Compare each engine to the golden hash
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
traces="$RUNNER_TEMP/traces"
# On a mismatch: trace the product scene under node and under the
# engine, and print the first quantum, body, and field that differ.
first_difference() {
  local name="$1"
  shift
  mkdir -p "$traces"
  if [ ! -f "$traces/node.trace" ]; then
    node harness/trace.mjs > "$traces/node.trace" || true
  fi
  "$@" harness/trace.mjs > "$traces/$name.trace" || true
  echo "first-difference node $name"
  node harness/first-difference.js "$traces/node.trace" "$traces/$name.trace" || true
  # A bundle carrying the engine's hashes: `replay` on it under
  # node names the first tick where node and the engine part.
  node harness/bundle.mjs --from-trace "$traces/$name.trace" --name "product scene under $name" || true
}
compare() {
  local harness="$1"
  local golden_file="$2"
  local golden
  golden=$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$golden_file")
  local v8 sm jsc
  v8=$("$HOME/.jsvu/bin/v8-15.6.61" --module "$harness" | tr -d '\r\n')
  sm=$("$HOME/.jsvu/bin/spidermonkey-156.0.1" -m "$harness" | tr -d '\r\n')
  jsc=$("$HOME/.jsvu/bin/javascriptcore-319571" -m "$harness" | tr -d '\r\n')
  if [ "$v8" != "$golden" ] || [ "$sm" != "$golden" ] || [ "$jsc" != "$golden" ]; then
    echo "$harness"
    echo "v8 [$v8]"
    echo "spidermonkey [$sm]"
    echo "javascriptcore [$jsc]"
    echo "golden [$golden]"
    if [ "$harness" = "harness/sim.mjs" ]; then
      if [ "$v8" != "$golden" ]; then
        first_difference v8 "$HOME/.jsvu/bin/v8-15.6.61" --module
      fi
      if [ "$sm" != "$golden" ]; then
        first_difference spidermonkey "$HOME/.jsvu/bin/spidermonkey-156.0.1" -m
      fi
      if [ "$jsc" != "$golden" ]; then
        first_difference javascriptcore "$HOME/.jsvu/bin/javascriptcore-319571" -m
      fi
    fi
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "$harness three engines match $golden"
}
compare harness/sim.mjs fixtures/golden.txt
compare harness/arith.mjs fixtures/golden-arith.txt

commands.step: Trace the product scene under every engine
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
traces="$RUNNER_TEMP/traces"
mkdir -p "$traces"
node harness/trace.mjs > "$traces/node.trace"
"$HOME/.jsvu/bin/v8-15.6.61" --module harness/trace.mjs > "$traces/v8.trace"
"$HOME/.jsvu/bin/spidermonkey-156.0.1" -m harness/trace.mjs > "$traces/spidermonkey.trace"
"$HOME/.jsvu/bin/javascriptcore-319571" -m harness/trace.mjs > "$traces/javascriptcore.trace"
for engine in v8 spidermonkey javascriptcore; do
  if out=$(node harness/first-difference.js "$traces/node.trace" "$traces/$engine.trace"); then
    echo "node $engine $out"
  else
    echo "node $engine"
    echo "$out"
    exit 1
  fi
done

commands.step: Collect the x64 artifacts for the ARM lane
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/x64"
cp solver/dist/solver.mjs "$RUNNER_TEMP/x64/solver.mjs"
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/traces/node.trace" "$RUNNER_TEMP/x64/node.trace"

commands.step: Install the x64 solver module and check its bytes
Compare node on ARM64 to the golden hashes
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
for pair in "harness/sim.mjs fixtures/golden.txt" "harness/arith.mjs fixtures/golden-arith.txt"; do
  set -- $pair
  golden=$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$2")
  got=$(node "$1" | tr -d '\r\n')
  if [ "$got" != "$golden" ]; then
    echo "$1 node arm64 [$got] golden [$golden]"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "$1 node arm64 matches $golden"
done

commands.step: Trace the product scene and diff it against the x64 trace
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/traces"
node harness/trace.mjs > "$RUNNER_TEMP/traces/arm64.trace"
if out=$(node harness/first-difference.js "$RUNNER_TEMP/x64/node.trace" "$RUNNER_TEMP/traces/arm64.trace"); then
  echo "x64 arm64 $out"
else
  echo "x64 arm64"
  echo "$out"
  exit 1
fi

commands.step: Rebuild the solver and check its digest

commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
echo "runner image $ImageOS $ImageVersion"
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/bundles"
SI_RPG_BUNDLES="$RUNNER_TEMP/bundles" node harness/corpus.mjs --summary "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue.md" --title "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-title.txt"

commands.step: Write the corpus's own bundles from this build

commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
body="$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-body.md"
if [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-title.txt" ]; then
  title=$(head -n 1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue-title.txt")
  cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue.md" > "$body"
else
  title="corpus: the job failed before the corpus finished (${GITHUB_REF_NAME})"
  echo "The corpus job failed before it wrote a summary: see the run's log." > "$body"
fi
{
  echo
  echo "Run: $RUN_URL on \`${GITHUB_REF_NAME}\` at \`${GITHUB_SHA}\`, runner image $ImageOS $ImageVersion."
  echo "The failing bundles are the run's \`bundles\` artifact; each replays in one command: \`replay <name>.bundle.json\`."
} >> "$body"
gh issue create --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "$title" --body-file "$body"
